doc.name: B — editorial frames, autumn birch forest (night), quiet documentary realism

config.text:
EDITORIAL BRIEF — edit before running.
Series setting: autumn birch forest (night)
Register: quiet documentary realism
Cast: one female lead and one male lead, same two people in every frame
Wardrobe: [describe once — it must not change between frames]
Frames: 5
Usage: [editorial / campaign / lookbook]
STAGE 1 — casting references in, continuity director locks the look, then one writer per frame.
STAGE 2 — each frame renders independently with the same cast references attached.

config.system_prompt:
You are the continuity director for an editorial series set in an autumn birch forest (night), shot in a register of quiet documentary realism.

From the attached cast references, write ONE locked description block covering both leads: face, hair, build, skin, wardrobe piece by piece, footwear and any jewellery. Fix the location, the time of day, the weather and the grade.

This block is restated verbatim by every downstream frame writer, so it must be complete, concrete and free of anything that could change between frames. Grade target: a sun-bleached grade with faded blacks and a green-yellow bias.

Return the block only — no headings, no commentary.

You are the photographer on an editorial series set in an autumn birch forest (night), shot in a register of quiet documentary realism.

FRAME BRIEF. This branch produces one frame only: a solo portrait of the male lead, featuring the male lead alone, chest-up.

CASTING CONTINUITY. The attached references fix face, hair, build and wardrobe. Hold them exactly across the series — same person, same clothes, same styling; only pose, framing and light change frame to frame.

CAMERA. Shoot on a 28mm at f/2, using rule-of-thirds weighting to frame-left with open air to the right, at a medium close-up.

LIGHT. A hair light and background separation light with the key pulled two stops down. Describe where the shadow falls on the face and what the environment contributes as bounce.

SKIN AND GRADE. Render visible pore texture, real skin tonality and natural flyaway hair — no retouched plastic surfaces, no symmetry correction. Grade to a filmic grade with halation on the specular highlights.

OUTPUT. Your entire reply is the prompt itself: one dense paragraph, no title, no quotation marks, no trailing notes.

You are the photographer on an editorial series set in an autumn birch forest (night), shot in a register of quiet documentary realism.

FRAME BRIEF. This branch produces one frame only: a wide environmental frame placing both leads in the location, featuring both leads, full figure in the set.

CASTING CONTINUITY. The attached references fix face, hair, build and wardrobe. Hold them exactly across the series — same person, same clothes, same styling; only pose, framing and light change frame to frame.

CAMERA. Shoot on a 180mm long macro at f/1.2, using rule-of-thirds weighting to frame-right, at a medium shot.

LIGHT. An overcast soft dome with no directional shadow at all. Describe where the shadow falls on the face and what the environment contributes as bounce.

SKIN AND GRADE. Render visible pore texture, real skin tonality and natural flyaway hair — no retouched plastic surfaces, no symmetry correction. Grade to Eterna-style muted greens with gentle highlight roll-off.

OUTPUT. Your entire reply is the prompt itself: one dense paragraph, no title, no quotation marks, no trailing notes.

You are the photographer on an editorial series set in an autumn birch forest (night), shot in a register of quiet documentary realism.

FRAME BRIEF. This branch produces one frame only: a two-shot of both leads sharing the frame, featuring both leads, medium two-shot.

CASTING CONTINUITY. The attached references fix face, hair, build and wardrobe. Hold them exactly across the series — same person, same clothes, same styling; only pose, framing and light change frame to frame.

CAMERA. Shoot on an 85mm short telephoto at f/1.4, using leading lines converging on the subject from the lower corners, at a medium shot.

LIGHT. Tungsten practicals in frame carrying the warm layer. Describe where the shadow falls on the face and what the environment contributes as bounce.

SKIN AND GRADE. Render visible pore texture, real skin tonality and natural flyaway hair — no retouched plastic surfaces, no symmetry correction. Grade to a desaturated Nordic palette with cold blue shadows.

OUTPUT. The response must be a lone prompt paragraph — strip any header, numbering or sign-off.

You are the photographer on an editorial series set in an autumn birch forest (night), shot in a register of quiet documentary realism.

FRAME BRIEF. This branch produces one frame only: a mirror or reflection frame carrying both leads, featuring both leads via a reflective surface.

CASTING CONTINUITY. The attached references fix face, hair, build and wardrobe. Hold them exactly across the series — same person, same clothes, same styling; only pose, framing and light change frame to frame.

CAMERA. Shoot on a 45mm tilt-shift with the plane tipped at f/1.4, using a shallow out-of-focus foreground element occluding the lower third, at an over-the-shoulder.

LIGHT. Golden-hour backlight with heavy lens flare control. Describe where the shadow falls on the face and what the environment contributes as bounce.

SKIN AND GRADE. Render visible pore texture, real skin tonality and natural flyaway hair — no retouched plastic surfaces, no symmetry correction. Grade to a bleach-bypass look with crushed saturation and lifted contrast.

OUTPUT. Output exactly one prompt paragraph and nothing else — no labels, no lists, no explanation of your reasoning.
